translationRepairs: On guiyou in the first month of Kaiping 2 the Emperor presided at Jinxian Hall while chief ministers, the full civil and military establishment, and envoys from the circuits offered congratulations; one hundred fifty-seven circuit tribute graduates were presented at Chongyuan Gate.
